display_long_description:
Start your engines and get ready for the ultimate kart racing rush! 🏁

Kart Rush Racing Game puts you in the driver's seat of an exciting VR kart racing experience built for Meta Quest. Grab the wheel, hit the accelerator, and race through thrilling tracks filled with fast corners, challenging turns, and plenty of opportunities to prove your racing skills.

Feel the excitement of kart racing from an immersive first-person perspective. Control your kart, improve your driving technique, find the perfect racing line, and push yourself to set faster lap times.

🔥 Fast-Paced Kart Racing
Jump into your kart and experience exciting, high-speed races designed to keep you moving.

🏎️ Immersive VR Experience
Get behind the wheel and experience the race from the driver's seat with an engaging VR perspective.

🏁 Challenging Tracks
Take on winding corners, long straights, and challenging sections that test your control and timing.

⚡ Race for Victory
Push your kart to the limit, improve your lap times, and compete for the best results.

🎮 Made for Meta Quest
Enjoy an accessible and immersive kart racing experience designed for VR.

Pre-order now and get ready to hit the track!

Put on your Meta Quest headset, grab the wheel, and prepare for an adrenaline-filled kart racing adventure. The green light is waiting—are you ready to race? 🏆
